decisions.reason: Automatic import into MeetAlfred does not change how lead-category lists are created or managed in HubSpot.
The source changes HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred contact addition, not Apollo enrichment or enriched-contact transfer into HubSpot.
The source concerns the downstream HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred flow and leaves LinkedIn-to-HubSpot ingestion unchanged.
Importing HubSpot lists into MeetAlfred does not affect which LinkedIn URLs are stored in CRM records.

The candidate already requires seamless follow-up-list export, while the source establishes the general synchronization mode without specifically changing silent-lead recirculation or campaign cleanup behavior.
The source does not resolve or change how existing CRM records are identified before or after export.
The source establishes an operational HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred import mode but does not necessarily modify the task-local map of the MeetAlfred-to-HubSpot flow.
The synchronization mode does not change the required email or LinkedIn chat history shown in HubSpot.
The source does not alter the isolated test-account policy or the prohibitions on deleting campaigns and using existing leads for testing.
Importing lists into MeetAlfred does not change the HubSpot status values associated with replies or accepted LinkedIn connections.
The source requires list import from HubSpot but does not establish that Zapier can create a new MeetAlfred campaign or change the existing campaign-creation requirement.
The source changes lead-list synchronization behavior, not the integration of campaign email with MeetAlfred and HubSpot.
